headline: CBI Books Future Retail Founder Kishore Biyani in Alleged Rs904-Crore Loan Fraud
summary: India's CBI has booked Future Retail founder Kishore Biyani and his brother Rakesh in an alleged Rs904.32-crore bank fraud case following a complaint by State Bank of India.
why: State Bank of India is the country's largest lender, and loan default investigations highlight asset quality challenges within the domestic banking sector.

impacts.name: State Bank of India
impacts.why: SBI filed the fraud complaint regarding loans issued to Future Retail.
